title: W005 Excel MSForms interaction event oracle fixture

cleanRoom.source: Repo-owned manifest and VBA source consumed through public Excel/VBIDE automation.
cleanRoom.prohibited: No Office internals, decompilation, disassembly, or binary inspection.

prerequisites: Windows desktop session with Microsoft Excel installed.
Excel macro execution allowed for the generated workbook when opening the fixture.
Trust access to the VBA project object model enabled when generating through automation.
The Microsoft Forms 2.0 UserForm designer available through Excel/VBA.
A stable desktop scaling/theme should be recorded by the capture bead; this fixture does not claim event-order, coordinate, or pixel parity.
manualInteractionScript: Show the fixture modeless, capture the top-level window manifest and screenshot, and preserve the command logs under W005 evidence.
Click and move over OracleProbeLabel near top-left and center, then press inside it, drag outside its bounds, and release to exercise captured/out-of-bounds mouse coordinates.
Click OracleTextBox, type 'ab', press Backspace, press Tab, press Shift+Tab back to the TextBox, and record key, character, Change, focus, validation, and active-control rows.
Press Enter for the default CommandButton path, press Escape for the cancel CommandButton path, and press Alt+O and Alt+C for accelerator observations.
Click both CommandButtons directly, double-click each probe where practical, then close with the window close button to observe QueryClose and Terminate where available.
Repeat a modal run with ShowW005InteractionOracleModal before classifying lifecycle and pump ordering.

notes.scope: This fixture builds repo-owned Excel/MSForms oracle inputs only. It does not implement OxForms behavior and does not settle final MSForms event ordering by itself.
notes.labelGeometry: OracleProbeLabel intentionally reuses the W003/W004 label left/top/width/height point geometry for coordinate calibration continuity.
notes.events: Event handler names and argument names follow docs/specs/FM20_EVENT_FACTS.md. Live output from oxforms-xvx.3 remains the oracle evidence.
notes.coordinates: Mouse handlers log X and Y as msforms_event_args points. Raw screen_pixels, window_rect, screenshot_pixels, form_logical, and control_local derivations belong to the capture evidence.
notes.lifecycle: The code-behind logs Initialize, Activate, Deactivate, Resize, QueryClose, and Terminate when MSForms raises them, plus show_mode from the macro path.
notes.generatedArtifacts: Generated .xlsm files, screenshots, logs, exported worksheets, and hashes belong under docs/evidence/W005_input_interaction_model_exploration/ when captured.
